# ChannelSend <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ChannelSend:Void channel:Int32, bus:Int32, level:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | In | Int32 | required | A channel handle from [PlaySound](PlaySound), [PlayMusic](PlayMusic), [EmitSound](EmitSound) or [MovieChannel](MovieChannel). A channel that is over does nothing. |
| `bus` | In | Int32 | required | A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error. |
| `level` | In | Float32 | required | How much of the sound goes there: `1` as loud as the channel itself. `0` removes the send. Below 0 is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Also sends a channel to another bus, at a level of its own, while it plays on its own bus as before. Many sounds can share one reverb this way. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* The send takes the sound after the channel's [effects](AddChannelEffect), and pans it like the channel. A channel can send to 4 buses; a fifth is a runtime error. Changing the level glides over a few milliseconds. When the bus is freed, the send goes to the bus that it fed. [GetChannelSend](GetChannelSend) tells the level.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Include "<audio.bb>"
hall = CreateAudioBus()
verb = AddAudioEffect(hall, BB_EFFECT_REVERB)
AudioEffectParam verb, BB_EFFECTPARAM_MIX, 1 ; Only the reverb, the sound itself plays on its own bus.
ch = PlaySound(footstep)
ChannelSend ch, hall, 0.4
```
